text.p: Net profit 6.4 bln bolivars loss vs 72.9 bln bolivars loss
Sales 18.3 bln bolivars vs 23.4 bln bolivars
Cost of sales 11.8 bln bolivars vs 13.2 bln bolivars
General costs 4.9 bln bolivars vs 9.8 bln bolivars
Financing cost 4.3 bln bolivar gain vs 23.5 bln bolivar loss
Other costs 10.6 bln bolivars vs 4.0 bln bolivars
Cost of discontinued operations none vs 3.9 bln bolivars
Results are inflation-adjusted; accounts are consolidated but not audited.
Corimon is a paints and packaging manufacturer.

Financial difficulties at foreign subsidiaries in the United States and Argentina saw Corimon suspended from the trading in the Caracas and New York Stock Exchange in February 1996. Caracas trade was reinstated in October, last year.
